records.source: A Stardew Valley rose? That's so lovely! Thank you!$h#$b#Whenever I miss the valley, I'll smell this rose. Hehe.$h#$b#Here, take this. It's been on the shelf for 10 years and no one has bought it. You can have it!
records.translation: Rosas ng Stardew Valley? Napakaganda! Salamat!$h#$b#Sa tuwing nami-miss ko ang lambak, aamuyin ko ang rosas na ito. Hehe.$h#$b#Heto, kunin mo ito. Sampung taon na ito sa estante at wala pang bumili. Sa iyo na!

records.source: Oh, wow! Nothing says 'spring' like a Stardew Valley daffodil!$h
records.translation: Ah, wow! Walang higit na nagsasabing “tagsibol” kaysa isang narsiso mula sa Stardew Valley!$h

records.source: Wow, that's so rare... I can't believe you're giving this to me! Thanks, honey!
records.translation: Wow, napakabihira niyan... Hindi ako makapaniwalang ibinibigay mo ito sa akin! Salamat, mahal!

records.source: Ahh... even in winter, Stardew Valley has beautiful flowers.
records.translation: Ahh... kahit taglamig, may magagandang bulaklak sa Stardew Valley.

records.source: I heard there's a rare weather event in the valley.#$e#I wish it rained here sometimes...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong may bihirang pangyayari sa panahon sa lambak.#$e#Sana umulan din dito paminsan-minsan...$s

records.source: How'd the big day go? Emily came up a while ago and told me all about your plans.#$b#I'll have to come visit you two on the farm sometime!
records.translation: Kumusta ang malaking araw? Umakyat dito si Emily kamakailan at ikinuwento sa akin ang lahat ng plano ninyo.#$b#Kailangan ko kayong dalawin sa bukid minsan!

records.source: *sniff*... Mmm... sweet peas have the most wonderful smell.
records.translation: *singhot*... Mmm... napakabango ng mga Gisantes na Mabango.

records.source: Hello hello, sweetie!#$b#I'm so glad that the bus is back in service. It was starting to get lonely out here.#$e#...I almost went out of business.$s#$e#Hey, but now you're here to buy a whole bunch of seeds... right, sweetie?$h
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal!#$b#Tuwang-tuwa akong bumibiyahe na ulit ang bus. Nagsisimula nang maging malungkot dito.#$e#...Muntik nang malugi ang negosyo ko.$s#$e#Pero narito ka na upang bumili ng napakaraming binhi... hindi ba, mahal?$h

records.source: You can find coconuts and cactus fruits outside. Feel free to take as many as you can find.#$e#They're oooh-yummy, too. Heeee!~$h
records.translation: Makakakita ka ng mga niyog at Prutas ng Kaktus sa labas. Kumuha ka ng kahit gaano karami ang makita mo.#$e#Oooh, masasarap din ang mga iyon. Heeee!~$h

records.source: Why hello there! If you see my friend Emily in town, could you tell her I said 'Hi'?#$e#Thanks!$h
records.translation: Aba, kumusta! Kung makita mo sa bayan ang kaibigan kong si Emily, maaari mo bang sabihing kinukumusta ko siya?#$e#Salamat!$h

records.source: That shady-looking guy in the back? I'm not supposed to talk about it.#$e#Anyway... what's the weather like in the valley?
records.translation: Iyong mukhang kahina-hinalang lalaki sa likod? Hindi ko dapat pinag-uusapan iyon.#$e#Siyanga pala... kumusta ang panahon sa lambak?

records.source: You wouldn't have much luck farming out here, honey.#$e#Well, unless you were a cactus farmer.$h
records.translation: Hindi ka gaanong susuwertihin sa pagsasaka rito, mahal.#$e#Maliban na lang kung magsasaka ka ng kaktus.$h

records.source: Hi! Welcome to Sandy's Oasis, the number one destination in Calico Desert!#$e#*whisper* Did I sound professional?$h#$e#Make sure to check out our seasonal seed selection.#$e#You look really thirsty. Here, have a taste of this ice cold milk. [184]#$e#Tasty, huh?$h
records.translation: Kumusta! Maligayang pagdating sa Oasis ni Sandy, ang pangunahing destinasyon sa Disyerto ng Calico!#$e#*bulong* Propesyonal ba ang dating ko?$h#$e#Tingnan mo ang aming pana-panahong mapagpipiliang binhi.#$e#Mukhang uhaw na uhaw ka. Heto, tikman mo itong napakalamig na gatas. [184]#$e#Masarap, hindi ba?$h

records.source: It's always sunny here, even in winter!#$e#Actually, it's a little hot for my tastes... my delicate skin burns quickly in the sun.$s
records.translation: Palaging maaraw dito, kahit taglamig!#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo mainit dito para sa akin... Madaling masunog sa araw ang maselan kong balat.$s

records.source: That shady-looking guy in the back? I'm really not supposed to talk about it.#$e#Anyway... what's the weather like in the valley?
records.translation: Iyong mukhang kahina-hinalang lalaki sa likod? Talagang hindi ko dapat pinag-uusapan iyon.#$e#Siyanga pala... kumusta ang panahon sa lambak?

records.source: Hey... I think I can trust you. You can keep a secret, right?#$b#*whisper* That guy in the back... it's some kind of exclusive club. I've never been inside myself, but they pay me a generous monthly rent so I don't ask any questions.#$e#SOOOOoo! How's that Stardew Valley weather right now?
records.translation: Uy... Sa tingin ko, mapagkakatiwalaan kita. Marunong kang magtago ng lihim, hindi ba?#$b#*bulong* Iyong lalaki sa likod... isang uri iyon ng eksklusibong samahan. Hindi pa ako nakapasok doon, pero nagbabayad sila sa akin ng malaking upa bawat buwan para wala akong itanong.#$e#KAYAAAaa! Kumusta ang panahon sa Stardew Valley ngayon?

records.source: My name's not really Sandy, you know. It's just good for business.#$e#But everyone calls me Sandy anyway, so I've just gotten used to it.
records.translation: Hindi talaga Sandy ang pangalan ko, alam mo. Maganda lang iyon para sa negosyo.#$e#Pero Sandy pa rin ang tawag sa akin ng lahat, kaya nasanay na lang ako.

records.source: Isn't it expensive, coming to the desert so often like you do?#$e#You must really like to see me, huh? Hmmm... $h||*sigh*... I do miss the beautiful flowers of Stardew Valley...$s
records.translation: Hindi ba mahal ang madalas mong pagpunta sa disyerto?#$e#Talagang gusto mo akong makita, ano? Hmmm... $h||*buntong-hininga*... Nami-miss ko ang magagandang bulaklak ng Stardew Valley...$s

records.source: Hi there, honey. Yep, it's just me, alone in this big old shop. Hmmm...#$e#Well, except for that creepy guy in the back. But he never moves a muscle, so I often forget about him.
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Oo, ako lang mag-isa sa malaki at lumang tindahang ito. Hmmm...#$e#Maliban sa nakatatakot na lalaki sa likod. Pero hindi siya kumikilos kahit kaunti, kaya madalas ko siyang makalimutan.

records.source: Hey, it's @! I'm glad to see you, kid. I was starting to think you'd never come back!#$e#If I didn't have this shop to run I'd come back to the valley with you for a day or two... just you and me on the old farm.$s#$e#You'll just have to visit me more often so I don't get depressed.$h
records.translation: Uy, si @! Natutuwa akong makita ka, bata. Akala ko hindi ka na babalik!#$e#Kung wala lang akong tindahang aasikasuhin, sasama ako sa iyo pabalik sa lambak nang isa o dalawang araw... tayong dalawa lang sa lumang bukid.$s#$e#Kailangan mo lang akong dalawin nang mas madalas para hindi ako malungkot.$h

records.source: Hi!~ Stay as long as you like.#$e#The air conditioning sure feels nice, doesn't it?
records.translation: Kumusta!~ Manatili ka hangga’t gusto mo.#$e#Ang sarap ng aircon, hindi ba?

records.source: Hey, you're pretty good at mining, for a human.
records.translation: Uy, mahusay ka sa pagmimina para sa isang tao.

records.source: Oh! I've read about this tradition... it's a 'birthday gift', isn't it? Hmm, very interesting...
records.translation: Ah! Nabasa ko ang tungkol sa tradisyong ito... “regalo sa kaarawan” ito, hindi ba? Hmm, lubhang kawili-wili...

records.source: Oh! I've read about this tradition... it's a 'birthday gift', isn't it?#$b#So, is it part of the tradition to give out garbage like this?
records.translation: Ah! Nabasa ko ang tungkol sa tradisyong ito... “regalo sa kaarawan” ito, hindi ba?#$b#Kaya bahagi ba ng tradisyon ang pagbibigay ng ganitong basura?

records.source: I can't see the color green very well.#$b#I guess it's part of living underground for so long.
records.translation: Hindi ko makita nang maayos ang kulay berde.#$b#Marahil bahagi iyon ng matagal na paninirahan sa ilalim ng lupa.

records.source: *sniff*... is this milk? *sip*... hmm... tastes good.
records.translation: *singhot*... gatas ba ito? *higop*... hmm... masarap.

records.source: I got all this stuff from the surface. I just take it from your people during the night.#$e#Hmm? What is this concept you call "private property"?
records.translation: Nakuha ko sa ibabaw ang lahat ng bagay na ito. Kinukuha ko lang ang mga ito mula sa mga kalahi mo tuwing gabi.#$e#Hmm? Ano itong konseptong tinatawag ninyong “pribadong pag-aari”?

records.source: Ah, 'milk'... *slurp*... How interesting. Remind me, again... where exactly does this juice come from?#$b#...!!! *sploosh*
records.translation: Ah, “gatas”... *lagok*... Lubhang kawili-wili. Ipaalala mo nga sa akin... saan mismo nanggagaling ang katas na ito?#$b#...!!! *tilamsik*

records.source: Ah... cave carrot stew, cave carrot roast, cave carrot soup and cave carrots au gratin.#$e#...And a ramekin of cave carrot brulee to sweeten the night.#$e#What?
records.translation: Ah... nilagang Karot sa Yungib, inihaw na Karot sa Yungib, sopas ng Karot sa Yungib, at Karot sa Yungib na au gratin.#$e#...At isang maliit na mangkok ng crème brûlée na Karot sa Yungib upang patamisin ang gabi.#$e#Ano?

records.source: If you enter the volcano on Ginger Island, you might encounter others like me. Don't be alarmed! We're peaceful with humans.
records.translation: Kung papasok ka sa bulkan sa Isla ng Luya, baka makatagpo ka ng iba pang tulad ko. Huwag kang mabahala! Mapayapa ang pakikitungo namin sa mga tao.

records.source: You know, you're pretty good at mining, for a human.
records.translation: Alam mo, mahusay ka sa pagmimina para sa isang tao.

records.source: Oh, you caught a Stonefish? I know them very well. We sometimes keep them as pets.
records.translation: Ah, nakahuli ka ng Isdang Bato? Kilalang-kilala ko ang mga iyon. Minsan ay inaalagaan namin sila bilang mga alaga.

records.source: Oh, you caught an Ice Pip? They're energetic little fish, despite the frigid environment they live in. My people avoid the frozen areas, though... too cold!
records.translation: Ah, nakahuli ka ng Yelong Pip? Masisiglang maliliit na isda sila sa kabila ng napakalamig na kapaligirang tinitirhan nila. Pero iniiwasan ng mga kababayan ko ang mga nagyeyelong lugar... napakalamig!

records.source: Oh, you caught a Lava Eel? Very good! Lava Eel fishing is a big part of our culture. They're considered a delicacy!
records.translation: Ah, nakahuli ka ng Igat ng Lava? Napakahusay! Malaking bahagi ng kultura namin ang pangingisda ng Igat ng Lava. Itinuturing silang napakasarap na pagkain!

records.source: You found the legendary Dwarvish Forge? Incredible... I've never seen it, myself.#$e#The machinery is so old, none of my people understand how it works. But it's definitely Dwarvish technology.
records.translation: Nahanap mo ang maalamat na Pandayan ng mga Duwende? Kamangha-mangha... Hindi ko pa iyon nakita.#$e#Napakaluma ng makina kaya wala sa mga kababayan ko ang nakauunawa kung paano iyon gumagana. Pero tiyak na teknolohiya iyon ng mga Duwende.

records.source: Hey, wanna buy something?
records.translation: Uy, gusto mong bumili?

records.source: Long ago, my people knew the secrets of advanced technology. The archaeological evidence proves that.#$e#But I wonder where it came from? And where did it all go? I guess some questions will never be answered...
records.translation: Noong unang panahon, alam ng mga kababayan ko ang mga lihim ng abanteng teknolohiya. Pinatutunayan iyon ng ebidensiyang arkeolohiko.#$e#Pero saan kaya iyon nagmula? At saan napunta ang lahat? Marahil may mga tanong na hindi kailanman masasagot...

records.source: I feel most comfortable underground.#$e#The deeper underground the better.
records.translation: Pinakakomportable ako sa ilalim ng lupa.#$e#Habang mas malalim, mas mabuti.

records.source: You've never seen a dwarf before, have you?
records.translation: Hindi ka pa nakakita ng duwende, hindi ba?

records.source: The mines can be a treacherous place. Be careful, friend.
records.translation: Maaaring mapanganib ang mga Minahan. Mag-ingat ka, kaibigan.

records.source: It's dangerous in the mines. Why don't you buy a few things from my shop to ensure your safety?
records.translation: Mapanganib sa mga Minahan. Bakit hindi ka bumili ng ilang bagay sa tindahan ko upang matiyak ang kaligtasan mo?

records.source: One day you'll have to tell me about this beverage you call "milk".
records.translation: Balang araw, kailangan mong ikuwento sa akin ang inuming tinatawag ninyong “gatas”.

records.source: You're not a spy sent by the Shadow People, are you?#$e#I'm keeping my eye on you.
records.translation: Hindi ka espiya na ipinadala ng Mga Taong-Anino, hindi ba?#$e#Binabantayan kita.

records.source: Most humans fear the unknown... that's why I've hidden my shop here.#$e#Your mining skills prove you're trustworthy.
records.translation: Natatakot ang karamihan sa mga tao sa hindi nila alam... kaya itinago ko rito ang tindahan ko.#$e#Pinatutunayan ng kakayahan mo sa pagmimina na mapagkakatiwalaan ka.
